data.body: Final local verification before Gerrit: focused oracle 12 passed; exact-defect timestamp mutation forced the two fail-fast clock controls RED and restoration returned them GREEN; make lint PASS; make typecheck PASS; make test PASS (8519 passed, 39 skipped, 175 deselected, 17 warnings in 1873.03s). Independent five-axis review approved. First local rebar review-code PASS had one advisory that the equality guard is not behaviorally gated and timestamp controls looked inert. A private-identity assertion was deliberately rejected as a refactoring-litmus violation; timestamp controls were strengthened to fail-fast on any clock read, mutation re-proven, commit amended, and second review-code returned PASS with 0 blocking / 0 advisory. Commit 662e0f9 retains Change-Id Iaed6da2adffa9cb03e9cbc2f1e8ad739ad4e3e77, DCO, and resolved rebar-ticket trailer.
